lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，我划开整片海。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail cuts the whole sea open.

lines.zh: 贴着沙底游，影子在上面。
lines.en: I glide along the sand, my shadow on the surface.

lines.zh: 绕礁石转半圈，找血腥味。
lines.en: I round the reef, hunting for the smell of blood.
Water presses past my gills; it's cold.

lines.zh: 光在头顶晃，我贴着海床走。
lines.en: Light sways overhead; I keep to the seabed.
The school of fish parts to let me through.
I swim slowly, but I turn fast.
It's darker down here; I follow scent.

lines.zh: 海底的骨头我绕了过去。
lines.en: I swim around the bones on the seabed.

lines.zh: 一整个下午，我只绕这一圈。
lines.en: All afternoon I circle the same water.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，我停不下来。
lines.en: My gills open and close; I can't stop moving.
Kelp drags along my flank and tickles.
I ride the warm current for a while.

lines.zh: 前面的水面在动，去看看。
lines.en: The surface ahead is moving; I'll look.
This trench is deep enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 海面下雨了，一滴一滴砸下来。
lines.en: Rain hits the surface, drop after drop.
I hang in the water and do nothing at all.

lines.zh: 有只鱼在我嘴边游，我没动。
lines.en: A fish swims by my mouth, and I don't move.

lines.zh: 今天不饿，但我也说不准。
lines.en: I'm not hungry today, though I can't be sure.
A fine layer of sand settles on my scales.
That smell of blood hasn't faded yet.

lines.zh: 吐出一个气泡，看它升上去。
lines.en: I let a bubble go and watch it rise.

lines.zh: 不远处的潮涌核心让我很平静。
lines.en: The conduit nearby keeps me calm.
The water's weight rests on my back, pleasantly.

lines.zh: 我在数头顶游过几条鱼。
lines.en: I'm counting the fish passing overhead.
Wounds heal; it just takes waiting.

lines.zh: 阳光只到这么深就没了。
lines.en: Sunlight ends at this depth.

lines.zh: 嘴巴开合，牙齿排得整齐。
lines.en: I open my jaws; the teeth sit in neat rows.

lines.zh: 这片水域安静得不像话。
lines.en: This patch of water is unnaturally quiet.
I can't be bothered; I'll drift a while.
Legs in the water — I see them.
You're on land, and I can't follow.
There's a cut on you.

lines.zh: 手指一入水，我就知道位置。
lines.en: One finger in the water tells me where you are.
I circle you twice.
I hear your heartbeat clearly.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，影子落进我眼里。
lines.en: You stand on shore; your shadow falls into my eye.
Coming down? I'll wait.
I don't like that boat.
Only water stands between us.
I bolt, throwing water everywhere.
Missed the bite. One lap, then again.
Blood spreads in the water, and it's mine.
I pause for half a beat, then swim on.
Something hit me near the gills; it stings.
I roll once in the water.
A gash has opened along my fin.
I retreat behind the rocks a moment.
Salt water works into the wound.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，没咬到东西。
lines.en: I open my jaws and catch nothing.
Blood in the water; a little is enough.
That meat is sinking from the surface.
I'm not picky; if it moves, it'll do.
Don't pull your hand back so fast.
I smell a wound, very faint.
I swim toward that smell.
Throw another; I'm not full.
That meat isn't bleeding; I won't touch it.

lines.zh: 嘴边都是水，我咬了个空。
lines.en: My mouth fills with water; I bite at nothing.
That smell sets me on edge.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的鳃缝，水乱了。
lines.en: You hit my gill slits; the water churns.

lines.zh: 我的皮很粗，你的手会疼。
lines.en: My hide is rough; your hand will hurt.

lines.zh: 沙扬起来，鳃里全是浑水。
lines.en: Sand lifts; my gills fill with cloudy water.
Don't shove me in the water.

lines.zh: 我撞回去，只用了一分力。
lines.en: I bump back, using a fraction of my strength.
My scales scrape your leg.
That wasn't an attack, only a reminder.
Back off; I can't turn around here.
Bubbles fog my eyes, so I shake my head.
Touch me again and the jaws open.

lines.zh: 另一条影子从深处游来。
lines.en: Another shadow rises from the deep.
We swim side by side, tails in rhythm.
I nudge her flank with my snout.
I circle her, unhurried.
This sea is big enough for pups.
The scent of the water has changed.
She heads deeper, and I follow.

lines.zh: 两条背鳍并排，划过海床。
lines.en: Two dorsal fins cut side by side over the seabed.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，这时候我脾气差。
lines.en: Don't come close; my temper is short now.
Down here it's quiet, and there's only us.
I bite down and shake it twice.
Meat between my teeth, blood spreading in the water.
This fish is too small to fill anything.
Carrying this, I swim crooked.
I bit too hard, and it broke.
I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 嘴里多出一颗牙，是别人的。
lines.en: There's an extra tooth in my mouth; not mine.
I'll drag this down deep to eat.
It's stuck in my teeth, so I shake my head.
Holding the catch, I sink slowly.
That one is hurt.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，方向清楚。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water; I know the direction.

lines.zh: 它游得不对劲，我盯上了。
lines.en: It swims wrong, and I've noticed.
Locked on; I go straight in.
That fish is missing scales.
It's breathing hard, and I hear it.
I won't chase far; just this one.
My tail drops and I accelerate.
Within eight blocks, it can't escape.
It smells like it's fading.

lines.zh: 我从下方贴近，它看不见。
lines.en: I come up from below, out of its sight.
One loop, and I cut off the escape.
It turns, and I turn with it.
My dorsal fin slices the surface.
Two blocks closer and the jaws open.
It hides in a crevice, and I wait.
The current tells me where it went.
No rush; it can't outlast me in water.

lines.zh: 我把身子压向海床，只露背鳍。
lines.en: I press to the seabed, only my dorsal fin showing.
I chase whoever tastes of blood.
I bite down, and the water turns red.
I shake my head and tear a piece free.
I ram it and roll it over.
Row after row of teeth close.
It breaks free, and I bite again.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽在水里，声音很闷。
lines.en: My tail cracks the water with a dull sound.
My teeth sink in; I don't let go.
Blood clouds my eyes.
I circle it, looking for the next opening.
Once I bite, I don't let go.
One sniff of blood and I come.
My fin breaks the surface first.
This stretch of sea has no master.
The water darkens; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片海走第一圈。
lines.en: I make my first circuit of these waters.
New water floods my gills, thick with salt.

lines.zh: 浅滩的沙子在我腹下流过。
lines.en: Shallow sand slips beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 有血味，很远，但我闻到了。
lines.en: There's blood far off, and I smell it.

lines.zh: 海岸线在那边，我记住了。
lines.en: The shoreline is there; I've marked it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下沉，先看清地形。
lines.en: I sink slowly and take in the terrain.

lines.zh: 水面上有火，我的皮被燎了。
lines.en: Fire on the water has scorched my hide.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔进海里，骨头闷响。
lines.en: I hit the sea from a height, and my bones thud.

lines.zh: 离开水太久，鳃里像着了火。
lines.en: Out of the water too long; my gills feel like fire.

lines.zh: 水底炸开，冲击把我推出老远。
lines.en: The seabed bursts and the shock throws me far.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿水面，扎进我背上。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the surface and sticks in my back.

lines.zh: 一股怪力箍住我，鳃都张不开。
lines.en: A strange force clamps me so my gills can't open.

lines.zh: 饿得发晕，我连小鱼都追不上。
lines.en: I'm so starved I can't even catch small fish.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and my whole body goes numb.
There is no water around me now, only emptiness.
